camel_example: aliyun ens AssociateEnsEipAddress --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId 'lb-5saivuir6b1mupxjfbhmk0000' --AllocationId 'eip-5sc1sgcrsrwgwdvx44hru0000' --InstanceType SlbInstance --Standby true
description_en: Associates an elastic IP address (EIP) with a cloud resource that is deployed in the same region
description_zh: 调用AssociateEnsEipAddress将弹性公网IP（EIP）绑定到同节点的云产品实例上
kebab_example: aliyun ens associate-ens-eip-address --allocation-id eip-5sc1sgcrsrwgwdvx44hru0000 --instance-id lb-5saivuir6b1mupxjfbhmk0000 --instance-type SlbInstance --standby true --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateEnsEipAddress

parameters.help_en: The ID of the EIP that you want to associate
parameters.name: allocation_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cloud service with which the EIP is associated.

You can specify the ID of an Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
绑定EIP的云产品ID。
支持负载均衡（ELB）实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of instance with which you want to associate the EIP. Valid values:

Nat: NAT gateway.

SlbInstance: Edge Load Balancer (ELB) instance.

NetworkInterface: secondary elastic network interface (ENI).

NatSlbInstance: If you want to associate multiple EIPs with an ELB instance, you need to set the parameter to this value.

EnsInstance (default): ENS instance
parameters.help_zh:
EIP实例的类型，取值：

Nat：NAT网关。
SlbInstance：负载均衡（ELB）。
NetworkInterface：辅助弹性网卡。
NatSlbInstance：ELB绑定多EIP时，需要选此值。
EnsInstance（默认值）：ENS实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the EIP is a secondary EIP. Valid values:

true

false
parameters.help_zh:
是否备用EIP。取值：

true：备用。

false：非备用
parameters.name: standby
